howtogo.configuration.ui_theme.tooltip:
Which style this mod's interfaces are drawn in.

dark: always the black style the mod has always had.
light: always the white style -- white sheets, near-black text and Google Maps' blue for anything that can be acted on, keeping the same simple, flat, text-and-hairline look.
auto (the default): follows the world -- white while the sky is bright, black once it is dark, and always black in the Nether, the End and any other dimension without a sky. It reads the same sky-brightness value the sky itself is shaded by, so it turns over when the sun does and a thunderstorm darkens it too.

A client setting: nothing in the world changes and nothing is sent to a server. A change takes effect on the next frame, across every screen this mod opens, including the navigation panel and the destination page inside MCphone.
